subject: After running doCRMAv2, I got chromosome 24,25

messages.author: 829edb046441d165
messages.subject: After running doCRMAv2, I got chromosome 24,25
parts:
Hi, 

After I ran doCRMAv2, and exported the raw copy number. Everything is ok but there are chromosome 24 and 25. I suppose 23 is chromosome X.I do not understand why are 24 and 25 chromosomes from?
I am using CytoScan HD array

Br,
Chengyu

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] After running doCRMAv2, I got chromosome 24,25
parts:
Chr 23 = Chr X
Chr 24 = Chr Y
Chr 25 = Chr M (Mitochondrial)

/Henrik
